meta.title: The Holiday Club
meta.textType: a day plan to the half hour

paragraphs: This week I go to the holiday club at school. Teacher Kim and Mia are there, too. Today is boat day. A paper with the times is on the wall. At nine o'clock, we come in and sit down. At half past nine, we build paper boats. Teacher Kim shows us how to fold the paper. Most children make a small boat. Mine is terrible, and the paper is very weak! "Try again," says Teacher Kim. At ten o'clock, we have a break.

At half past ten, we put a sail on every boat. Pat is seven, and he is very small. He can't finish his boat, so Mia helps him. At eleven o'clock, we put the boats on the water. The water is in a big box on the floor. "Go, boat, go!" says Pat. His boat goes down the box. My boat is slow, but it does not stop. Mia's boat is the quickest. Then one boat gets wet and goes down in the water. Pat laughs, and so do we.

At twelve o'clock, we eat lunch. After lunch, we go to the school pool. At half past one, we swim. We change our clothes first. Every child has a towel. I can't swim well, but Pat can. At three o'clock, we dry our boats and take them home. Mom comes for me at half past three. Is it a good day? Yes, it is the best day of the week!
text.summary: Lily tells the plan of one day at the holiday club at school. The children make paper boats and sail them in a big box of water.
